searches_run: WebSearch: Nancy Vaughan Greensboro mayor campaign website
WebSearch: Devin King Greensboro mayor 2015 campaign website
WebSearch: Vaughan Greensboro mayor re-elect campaign domains
WebSearch: Devin King Greensboro mayor candidate 2015 website OR facebook
WebSearch: Nancy Vaughan Greensboro mayor 2022 campaign website donate Outling
WebSearch: Greensboro mayor 2013 Vaughan Perkins candidate websites
Wikipedia pages for the 2013, 2015, 2017, 2022 Greensboro mayoral elections and Nancy Vaughan (via mac2): no campaign website links
greensboro.com 2015-08-11 article on Devin King and EzGreensboro blog post (via mac2): no website named
Our Campaigns Devin R. King page (search snippet): website listed as None
note: Searches ran. No mayoral campaign website was named in news or Wikipedia. electnancyvaughan.com has 200 captures in the window (2013 and 2017), and the archived pages name Nancy Vaughan. The site is for her 2009 Greensboro City Council At-Large campaign ('Paid for by the Committee to Elect Nancy Vaughan 2009', about page lists council and airport authority posts). None of the pages read mention a mayoral race, so the content test fails and it is rejected for this election and not accepted. nancyvaughan.com has in-window captures for 2013 and 2017 but belongs to another person (found at Stage 2). No 200 capture in the 2022 window for nancyvaughan.com or electnancyvaughan.com. Other guesses with no in-window 200 capture: vaughanformayor.com, nancyvaughanformayor.com, nancyvaughan2017.com, nancyvaughan2013.com, nancyvaughanmayor.com, vaughan4mayor.com, mayorvaughan.com, nancy4greensboro.com, reelectnancyvaughan.com, nancyvaughan2022.com, nancyvaughanforgreensboro.com. Ballotpedia returned HTTP 403 through mac2 and WebFetch, so Ballotpedia campaign website fields were not read. Some CDX requests failed on first try and were retried; empty results came from HTTP 200 responses except vaughanformayor.com 2017, which failed 3 times and is unverified for that window.
